# Survey Dashboard - Copilot Instructions

## Project Overview
React Vite project for building a survey dashboard application.

## Development Setup
- Node.js environment with npm
- Fast HMR (Hot Module Replacement) with Vite
- ESLint for code quality

## Key Commands
- `npm install` - Install dependencies
- `npm run dev` - Start development server
- `npm run build` - Build for production
- `npm run lint` - Run ESLint

## Project Structure
- `src/` - React components and application code
- `public/` - Static assets
- `dist/` - Production build output (generated)

## Development Guidelines
- Use React functional components with hooks
- Follow ESLint configuration for code quality
- HMR is enabled for fast development feedback
